Short Bio: Johanne is currently a lecturer at IMT Atlantique in the Computer Science department. Her main areas of interest are cybersecurity, and in particular privacy mechanisms and the protection of minorities. Johanne lives with her partner and their fabulously fluffy Akita Inu, Ôkami.

> cat shortCV

Working Experience

Jul, 2015 -- ongoing : Assistant professor @ IMT Atlantique, FR in the Computer Science Department. Major research areas includes cybersecurity and privacy protection. Member of the «sécurIté et Résilience des Systèmes d’Information» (IRIS) team at the CNRS Lab-STICC, UMR 6285.

Aug, 2014 -- Jun, 2015 : Research Engineer @ SWID, FR, R&D project manager on the DGA RAPID FRAG&TAG. Research and development activities around digital identity and the Internet of Things.

Jun, 2013 -- Jun, 2014 : Post-Doc Fellow @ Orange Labs, FR Title: «Identity management based on a Trusted Identity Module». Working within the Presence, Identity and Access (PIA) team.

Jan, 2010 -- Jun, 2013 : PhD candidate SFR, FR CIFRE doctoral student for SFR within the CNRS GREYC Laboratory, UMR 6072, at ENSICAEN (see subject below).
